reached_sql:
SELECT s.d_year AS d_year, i.i_brand_id AS brand_id, i.i_brand AS brand, SUM(s.sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           d.d_year AS d_year,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_moy = 11
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_year
) s
INNER JOIN item i ON s.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY s.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand
ORDER BY s.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
